scores.notes: Daniel in both is a lean older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, tan skin, in a dark blue fringed robe with a shoulder satchel (left centre-left, right foreground left).
Moses in both is an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, weathered face, dark brown cloak over a pale tunic (left with staff at shore, right seated on the stone).
Peter (left raising the lame man, right the dripping man by the fire) has dark curly greying hair, a short dark-grey beard, tanned face and a rough brown cloak in both.
Watson in both is a middle-aged man of medium build with brown side-parted hair and a brown moustache, dark overcoat and waistcoat, carrying a doctor's bag and bowler (worn on left, held on right).

Left Watson is stout and broad-faced with dark brown hair and a walrus moustache; the right shows two candidate Watsons at the door who differ from each other - a slim sandy-haired man Holmes pulls in by the arm (would conflict) and a stout dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag (would match) - so the subject is not singled out.
Moses in both has shoulder-length white hair and a full white beard, a brown cloak over a pale robe and a dark crooked staff (left on the rock at the sea, right striking the rock).
David in both is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in a short brown tunic (left dodging the spear, right smaller with the sling); no conflicting cue.

Moses in both is an elderly man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, lean tanned face, dark brown cloak over a pale robe with a wooden staff (left foreground, right seated on the stone).

Daniel in both has short cropped grey hair and a short grey beard, lean tanned face, a dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic and a scroll case at the hip (small in the den on the left, large on the right).

Left shows a white house ablaze at night under a dark sky with a lantern-lit lane; right is plain daylight at the station with only a distant smoke column and a small red-brick house, so time of day conflicts and the house itself is not shown on the right.
Watson in both is a sturdy middle-aged man with brown hair and a thick brown moustache, ruddy face, dark overcoat and grey waistcoat (left small in bowler with bag, right seated close up).

Both show a night-time parted sea under heavy dark cloud with a wet sandy-rocky seabed path between teal-green water and distant rocky headlands; left views it from the shore, right from inside the path where the walls tower higher.

Moses in both is an old man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, weathered tanned face, brown cloak over a pale robe and a staff (left standing by the camp, right seated with arms raised).
Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress with white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Peter (left at far left with hand on chest, right stepping out of the boat) has dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short dark-grey beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Peter (left foreground by the brazier, right standing on the boat's bow) has short curly dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left crouched at the brook, right kneeling to be anointed).
David in both is a slim clean-shaven youth with dark curly hair and tanned skin in a short brown tunic (left kneeling under the oil, right dodging the spear at far right).

Holmes in both is a gaunt clean-shaven man with dark slicked-back hair, high forehead, hooked nose and hollow cheeks in a dark frock coat and high collar (left in the armchair, right foreground on the street).

Both show an open circular pit lined with pale grey stone blocks sunk into sandy ground, with stone steps and a wall beside it and a pale early sky; the right is brighter and adds palms and a barred gate but nothing conflicts.
Alice in both is a fair young girl with long light-brown hair, yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings (left holding the flamingo, right seated at the table).

Both are night scenes of flat hedged English countryside with a fire sending up a tall smoke column among trees; the left shows it only as a distant glow from the station while the right shows the white gabled house ablaze up close, with nothing conflicting.

Moses in both is an elderly man with long white hair and a full white beard, tanned skin, a dark brown cloak over a pale robe with a brown sash and a crooked staff (left pointing at the pig, right raising the rod by the rock).

David in both is a lean clean-shaven teenage youth with dark tousled curly hair and tanned skin in a ragged brown tunic with a leather shoulder bag and sling (left at the brook, right standing behind fallen Goliath).

Watson on the left (standing, arms folded) has brown side-parted hair, a brown moustache and a ruddy face; the man on the bed on the right has the same brown hair, moustache, ruddy skin and dark waistcoat, though his forearm covers his eyes.

Moses in both is an old man with white wavy hair and a full white beard, tanned lined face, a brown cloak over a pale belted robe and a crooked staff (left raising the rod at the rock, right at the shore).
Peter (left leaping from the boat, right walking on the water) has short dark curly hair, a short greying dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in both; the cloak differs only as clothing.

On the left Jesus is only a tiny distant figure on the cross on the hilltop with no readable face, hair or beard; the right shows him clearly (long brown hair, beard, blue mantle), so identity cannot be compared.

Peter (left standing with the net, right foreground right with hand at his chest) has dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grizzled beard, tanned lined face and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Both show a white two-storey country house with chimneys ablaze in the dark, set back across a lawn with rose bushes, a curving drive, horse-drawn fire engines and hedged fields behind; the facade is drawn somewhat differently (angled gabled view left, symmetrical front right) but compatibly.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight light-brown hair held by a dark band, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings (left facing the Caterpillar, right centre with the flamingo).
David in both is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left kneeling under the oil, right crouched at the brook).

Alice in both has long wavy light-brown hair with a hairband, fair skin and rosy cheeks, yellow dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; she looks a little taller and older on the right but hair and face agree.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven youth with dark curly hair and tanned skin in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left with the sling behind Goliath, right fleeing at far right).

Peter (left lifting the lame man, right leaping from the boat) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grizzled beard, strong nose and brown cloak in both; the hair reads somewhat greyer on the right but not a clear conflict.

Both show a mown grass croquet lawn enclosed by a pinkish brick garden wall with hedges and tall trees behind, card-soldier hoops and hedgehogs on the grass in soft daylight; right adds cypresses and clipped topiary from a different angle.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single mast and furled sail on a wide lake ringed by low hills with a small hillside village on shore; the storm-night versus calm-dawn change is the one the passages ask for.

Left Peter (raising the lame man) has thick dark-grey curly hair, a grizzled dark beard and a heavy build; the man diving from the boat on the right has thin silver-white hair, a white-grey beard and an older, leaner face.

Left Holmes (at the door) is markedly balding with a bare high crown and thin dark hair at the sides; right Holmes (tossing the paper ball) has a full head of thick dark swept-back hair and sideburns and looks younger.

Both show a sandy seabed path between blue-green water under a dark cloudy moonlit sky, with tan rocky cliffs and a walled town on the far shore; left is seen from inside the path with towering walls, right from the beach as the waters open.
Moses in both is an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, tanned weathered face, brown cloak over a pale robe and a crooked staff (left leading the column, right seated on the stone).

Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight strawberry-blonde to light-brown hair, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings (left drinking from the bottle, right in the armchair at far right).

Both show a broad path running straight between towering dark-green walls of water under a dark night sky toward rocky hills with a crag at the far end; the ground is darker and muddier on the left and sandier on the right, and the left wall is paler, but the layout agrees.

Peter (left foreground by the brazier, right clasping the lame man's hand with a net over his shoulder) has short dark curly hair with grey, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak in both; he is smaller and slightly darker-haired on the right.

Holmes in both is a tall gaunt clean-shaven man with dark slicked-back hair, receding temples, a hooked nose and hollow cheeks in a long black frock coat (left pointing in the room, right stooping with the stick).
Jesus in both is a man in his thirties with shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and olive skin, in a white robe with a blue mantle (left before the tomb, right standing in the boat).

Watson in both is a solid middle-aged man with brown side-parted hair, a thick brown moustache and ruddy face in a dark suit and waistcoat (left seated close up, right at the door with bowler and bag).

Daniel in both has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard and a lean lined face, wearing a dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic with a scroll case at the hip; skin reads darker on the right under night lighting only.

Watson in both is a middle-aged man of medium build with brown hair, a brown moustache, bowler hat, brown-grey overcoat and a doctor's bag (left seated in the carriage, right standing on the pavement).
Both show a wet sandy seabed path receding between towering curling blue-green waves under a pale cloudy daytime sky, with red mesa cliffs on the far shore; only the viewpoint and the people differ.
Peter (left leaping from the boat, right standing with the net by the fire) has dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grizzled beard, tanned lined face and a ragged dark brown cloak in both.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and olive skin, wearing a cream robe with a blue mantle (left standing in the boat, right in profile pointing at the tomb).

Both show a wet sandy-rocky seabed strip opening through dark teal sea under heavy black storm cloud with a pale break at the horizon; left is from the shore as the waves part, right from inside the path with the walls towering.

Both show the same wet sandy seabed path strewn with shells and weed between towering curling teal-green waves under dark storm cloud with a pale gap at the far end; the right adds a rock mound mid-path and a warmer glow but nothing conflicts.

Left Watson (on the bed) has dark brown hair and a dark moustache; the right shows two candidate Watsons at the door who differ from each other - a slim sandy-haired man Holmes pulls in by the arm, and a stouter dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag - so the subject is not singled out.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight light-brown to strawberry-blonde hair, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings (left grown tall in the court, right drinking from the bottle).
Peter (left standing on the bow, right centre front with staff and net) has short curly dark-grey hair, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Both are night scenes of a white multi-storey country house with red-tiled roof and tall chimneys ablaze, horse-drawn red fire engines on the lawn in front, bare trees and hedged lanes around; the facade is longer on the left and boxier on the right but compatible from a different angle.

Peter (left foreground with hand on chest, right stepping out of the boat) has short curly greying hair, a short grizzled beard, strong nose, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both; he reads somewhat greyer and older on the left but not a clear conflict.
